page.overview:
Who is The Signalman?

The Signalman is a ficitonal character in Caitlin R. Kiernan's Tinfoil Dossier series, the only character who appears in all three books. He is a senior agent of the shadowy organization known as Albany, a cynical and burnt-out alcoholic who is nonetheless one of the agency's most effective assets. He has a reputation as "the one who never flinched," and as "one of the last of Albany’s True Believers, a stone-cold MiB, the agency man through and through." He is introduced as one of the main characters in Agents of Dreamland (2017), plays a minor but pivotal role in Black Helicopters (2018), and is again a prominent onstage figure in The Tindalos Asset (2020).

The character's full name is never given; his nickname comes from the railroad watch he always carries, manufactured by the Elgin Watch Company of Elgin, Illinois, in 1888. In The Tindalos Asset, we learn that his first name is Quentin. He has an apartment in the hills above Santa Monica, California.

He is born in 1960, in Birmingham, Alabama. When he is eight years old, in 1968, he watches a late-show movie on TV, The Star Maiden, that has a profound effect on him.

His career with Albany begins in 1981. By 2011, he is partnered with the supernatural assassin Ellison Nicodemo, who is also his lover. A botched attempt to terminate the Mythos-powered serial killer Jehosheba Talog leaves Nicodemo severely traumatized.
